depcruise.unknown-file: rules constrain dependencies or modules with dependencies; a file that lies in no declared context is not a dependency fact (no rule on file placement alone)

boundaries.cycle: no cycle rule (cycles are eslint-plugin-import `no-cycle`, a different tool)
boundaries.orphan: per-import lint rule: sees one file's imports, never the whole graph, so "no file imports this one" is not expressible
boundaries.fan-in: per-import lint rule: no dependent counts

archunit.package: the dependency graph holds project files only; imports of packages are dropped (resolved or not), so no rule can name a package
archunit.orphan: no orphan rule (file rules are dependency, cycle, naming and placement predicates)
archunit.fan-in: count metrics are per class (methods, fields, lines, statements); no per-file dependent count

unexpressible.dependency-inversion: ratio of interface to concrete constructor-injected dependencies per class against a threshold (CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS, symbol kinds)
unexpressible.port-dependency-inversion: same ratio as dependency-inversion, over the application layers
unexpressible.repository-pattern: a repository class in infrastructure must IMPLEMENT a domain interface (class roles, IMPLEMENTS)
unexpressible.port-adapter-pattern: an outbound adapter class must IMPLEMENT a port interface of the core (class roles, IMPLEMENTS)
unexpressible.use-case-isolation: use-case classes must not constructor-inject other use cases (class roles, CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS)
unexpressible.controller-no-entity: a controller class must not use an entity class (class roles; constructor injection and signature types)
unexpressible.domain-state-purity: a domain class must not hold infrastructure state (constructor injection of an infrastructure type; field data flow)
unexpressible.domain-stability: Martin instability of the domain layer against a threshold (layer-level metric)
unexpressible.module-fan-out: distinct file fan-out over IMPORTS against a threshold (no tool has a fan-out condition)
unexpressible.component-instability: Martin instability per file against a threshold (ArchUnitTS instability is per folder/project, not per file, and not filterable to mapped files)
unexpressible.abstraction-ratio: abstract classes and interfaces over all classes of the domain against a threshold
unexpressible.single-responsibility-proxy: public methods and constructor dependencies per class (ArchUnitTS methodCount counts all methods; no dependency count)
unexpressible.interface-segregation-proxy: methods per interface (ArchUnitTS count metrics read classes only)
unexpressible.naming-services: class names of application-layer classes (tools match file names, not declared class names)
unexpressible.naming-repos: class names of repository classes (tools match file names, not declared class names)
unexpressible.test-file-pairing: existence of a sibling test file (no tool rule on file existence)
unexpressible.no-index-logic: statement kinds declared inside index.ts barrels
unexpressible.value-object-immutability: mutable members (setters, non-readonly fields) of value-object classes
unexpressible.domain-event-placement: classes that implement or extend DomainEvent, outside the domain layer (type hierarchy)
unexpressible.application-service-thin: methods per application-service class (ArchUnitTS methodCount is close but counts every class member method of every class in a file, and our CONTAINS counts declared methods; not translated)
